title: FLA import: scene page-order may not match document order if Map iteration is non-deterministic
description: flash8-import.ts iterates pages using a for..of loop over a Map. The current code creates scenes from contents.sceneNames lookup but the actual page ordering depends on Map insertion order (which in JS is insertion order, which should match read order). This may be fine in practice, but verify that the page indices in the CPicPage records are used for ordering (not just iteration order). Research: in parseFla8Contents/buildFla8Document, check how pages are sorted/ordered before being passed to convertTimeline. If pages are already sorted by their index in the FLA binary, this is a false alarm — cancel the task. If not, sort by page index.
resolution: False alarm. flash8-import.ts line 1122 already calls pages.sort((x, y) => x.num - y.num) before iterating to build scenes. Page order is guaranteed by numeric page index, not Map insertion order.
